_note: The bought guns (Sci-Fi Battle Weapons by Tirgames; Phase 21, docs/PHASE_21_OVERNIGHT_PLAN.md): which model each SpeedKills gun wears when the paid files are here (npm run paid makes them, locally), and its procedural model otherwise. The legacy game never wears them. model is a file under models, always a _2 build: the pack's _1 of each family is the same gun (the same length, muzzle and sights, measured) in one piece, with no magazine, slide or pump a reload or a shot can move, so three guns that wore a _1 (rspn101, 3030, g2) kept their magazines in on a reload until pictures of each gun's builds showed it. skins is the order the gun's three skins come in as its fusion level rises (as found, levels 2 to 3, levels 4 to 5): a gun sharing a family with another starts from a different one, so the pair differs at a glance. Every model's measurements (its length, muzzle, sight top and its own sight line) are in src/config/paidmodels.json, which tools/checks/paid-weapons.ts writes off the models and fails when they part. One model a gun, by its class (the owner): the rifles wear SciFiRifle01, the two SMGs and the two shotguns one each, HAEFY and BOOG the sniper, CHOOCH the launcher (the pack's only drum-fed heavy), and APUHTHEE the second pistol (the owner, 2026-09-30: "yep use pitstol 02"; boxy and heavy, its slide moving on a shot, its own reflex sight, its magazine a block under the barrel). The first pistol and the rocket launcher fit no gun here. PULSAR, a fast marksman on the rifle, was taken out the same day. Guns sharing a model start in different skins, so they differ at a glance.
_textures2k: The skins again at 2048 (their glow at 1024), from the pack's 4096 originals: the gun in your hands wears these on the High preset, every other gun the 1024 set (the owner, 2026-09-28: "Yes raise the textures on high settings"). Only your own gun, since it fills a fifth of the view and a figure's gun a few pixels: a skin at 2048 is about 67 MB of texture memory on the card against 17 at 1024.
_glow: How bright a bought gun's glow (its emission map) is at each fusion level, 0 to 5: a step a level, so a fused gun reads as better at a glance. Ours.
_sights: The pack's own sights, which a bought gun is aimed down: a fitted optic never goes on top of them (the owner, 2026-09-27: our sights on top of the built-in ones, "we don't want that") and lends only its zoom and, magnified, its picture over the screen. parts: the sight parts by name, whose back the eye sits behind; a reticle dot is a part whose material is named for one (Dot), and the eye sits on its middle. ownScope: the families whose scope is one piece with the gun (the sniper's), sighted down the scope's axis. A gun with neither is sighted over its irons, the top of its rear half. Measured into paidmodels.json eye by tools/checks/paid-weapons.ts. ironsEye: how far in front of the eye a bought gun's iron sights come in the sights, metres before the view's scale (the procedural guns' 0.26): at 0.26 the hands were 20 cm from the eye and the soldier's forearms flanking them filled a quarter of the screen at 110 degrees (tools/pov-sheet.ts). dotEye: the same for a bought scope with a reticle dot (the rifle's, the steady SMG's, the launcher's): at the fitted optic's own eye relief, 7 cm, the scope's rim filled most of the screen. The launcher's sight is its Visor, a sight part too.
_fronts: A family whose front the measuring rules read wrong, and which end it is (1 its +Z end, -1 its -Z): the rocket launcher (SciFiRocketLauncher01, HAEFY's) has its twin tubes running 65 cm back from its pistol grip over the shoulder and 41 cm ahead, so the end farther from its origin is its back; measured, its trigger (z 0.4 to 2 cm) is in front of its pistol grip (z -9 to -1, 16 cm deep) only with +Z forward, and its foregrip (z 20 to 28) and its sight (the Visor, z 17 to 20) are ahead of the trigger then; the -Z end's two round openings are the tubes' back vents. Drawn the other way it fired from the vents.
_support: Where along each bought gun the support hand holds it, by family: the model's z (its grip at 0, the muzzle forward), chosen off the gun's underside profile (tools/checks/paid-weapons.ts measures the underside there, paidmodels.json support): the front of the receiver or the handguard ahead of the magazine, the pump on the pump gun, ahead of the drum on the launcher. The hand was where the procedural gun's handguard had been: on the USSO over the top of the bought gun, and in the sights beside its rear sight, a hand and forearm by the eye (the owner: the left arm out of place and covering the weapons). Ours, by eye against the profile.
_motion: How the pack's own moving parts move, since the pack gives its guns split into parts and no animations (paidgun.ts finds each part by name and hinges it at its measured edge; viewmodel.ts moves it). Radians, metres, seconds. trigger: how far it swings back on a shot, held that long and let go over release, so an automatic's stays in through a burst. drumRate: how quickly the launcher's drum turns to its next chamber (a chamber a shot, the angle between its rounds counted off the model), as a rate a second. spinnerTurns: the sniper's two side wheels, turns each over a rechamber (whole turns, so each comes to rest as it started); spinnerAim: turns more going into the sights, the zoom wound in. cover: how far the heavy shotgun's loading gate swings open, on a shell reload and with the pump. roundTravel: how far below its port the shell in the hand starts. buttonPress: how far a magazine release goes in at a reload's start. extruder: how far the rifle's extruder, under the receiver, drops on a shot. Ours.
_props: The rest of the pack where the game has the thing (W7): the model a prop wears when the paid files are here, and its skin. mine is the MINE hack's mine (ours was a lit ring); its size is the model's own. carepackage is a care package (ours was a lit cylinder), the 1.51 m weapon case drawn at scale, which reads from further off. healkit is the med kit standing in the middle of a HEAL area (ours was the lit ring alone), 0.40 by 0.38 m on its own base; Everyone's area has the same one. hackcore is a hack core on the floor, the pack's canister (0.19 m, drawn 2.2 times, 0.42 m) standing and turning, its glow in its slot's colour (mobility cyan, utility magenta); ours was a spinning coloured box, the second most common thing on the floor. A prop's lid is its opening part, and open how far it swings open about its back edge, radians. armorygun and armoryhack are the range armory's stands (armory.ts): a gun stands over the pack's weapon case in skin A (white) at 0.82, 1.24 m wide, about half the 2.4 m between stands, its cover open; a hack over the same case in skin B (black), so the two runs read as one set in two colours (the flat storage case, tried first, read as an open laptop).
_mount: A sight from another model of the pack mounted on a gun that has none but irons (a gun's mount: the model it comes from, the part, and where along this gun its middle goes, the model's z). The pack has no sight attachments of its own: its only sights are built into the rifle, the steady SMG and the launcher, and the steady SMG's reflex sight is a part of its own, so the USSO (irons only) wears it: the owner, 2026-09-27, "does the guns come with like red dot sights? we want to use those". It sits into this gun's top as far as it sits into its own gun's (both measured off the models as they load, paidgun.ts mountSight), and the gun is aimed down its dot.
